sql:
SELECT
  t0.public_id AS public_id,
  t1.name AS tenant_name,
  t0.request_type AS request_type,
  t0.status AS status,
  t0.received_at AS received_at,
  t0.completed_at AS completed_at,
  t0.created_at AS created_at,
  ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t0.created_at - t0.received_at)) / 86400.0, 1) AS days_received_to_created,
  LEFT(COALESCE(t0.notes, ''), 200) AS notes
FROM data_subject_requests t0
JOIN tenants t1 ON t1.id = t0.tenant_id
WHERE t0.received_at < DATE '2023-01-01'
ORDER BY t0.received_at ASC, t0.public_id ASC
note: Returns full history of data_subject_requests rows with received_at before 2023-01-01, one row each, with the received_at-to-created_at gap (in days) as the key diagnostic column; if this exceeds 50 rows only the first 50 by received_at will print, and the report should note the true row count.
